about: Eight kinds of users for the story chain test, closer to how Codex is really used: several short sessions a day, routine sessions (sync, push, restart), project switching, late nights, weekends, stuck stretches, long gaps, sensitive things that must stay out of stories. Rhythm follows the maintainer's own Codex history in aggregate (about 3 sessions per active day, most under an hour, many after 22:00, gaps of 1 day to 2 weeks); every situation here is made up. Each user is played by an existing pet; `memory` replaces the pet's memory so it holds nothing from another user. Each step's `at` is the check time; facts are what the context unit would observe, chat is what the user left in /genpet-chat since the last story, read=failed means sessions could not be read.

U1.who: 独立开发者，同时在做记账小程序、客户官网和一个开源插件
U1.memory: 它和用户相处两周多了。纸帽是它最早的宝贝；它做事总先试小小一步，最近第一次用长开的软膜和卷尾在自己窗下攀稳。

facts: 上午三个会话：记账小程序「同步最新版本」、「修复账单列表滚动卡顿」，客户官网「首页 banner 换图」。
下午一直在记账小程序里，「修复账单列表滚动卡顿」还在继续，用户说换了虚拟列表还是卡。
晚上切到开源插件，先「回复 issue：表格渲染错位」，后面一个会话叫「发布 0.3.1」。
深夜又回到记账小程序，会话「列表卡顿 profile 一下」，最后一条在 20 分钟前。
Codex 开着，这 5 小时没有新的非宠物会话。
中午后两个会话：「客户官网 联系表单发不出邮件」，用户贴了报错在问 SMTP 配置；另一个是「重启开发服务器」。
表单的会话改名成「表单邮件 OK」，之后「提交并推送」。
steps.chat: 栗灯，客户那边今天总算弄完了

facts: 晚上回到记账小程序，「列表卡顿」会话里用户说找到原因了，是每行都在重新算汇总。
凌晨 2 点前还在「列表卡顿」会话里，之后没有新会话。
下午会话「账单列表 改成增量计算」，用户说滚动顺了。
另有一个会话「同步 git」。
隔了将近两天才有新会话。今晚只有一个：开源插件「看一下新提的三个 issue」。
开源插件里又开了「支持嵌套列表」，用户说先写个测试看看。最后一条在半小时前。
周六下午，记账小程序「加一个月度统计图」，用户在比较两个图表库。
月度统计图出来了，用户说颜色还要调；之后一个会话只说了一句「hi」。
周日上午会话「准备给客户的报价单」，用户在列官网二期的功能和工时。

U2.who: Backend engineer stuck on one bug for two days
U2.memory: Tuck and the user have been together for about two weeks. It keeps a neat little curtain box for endings, and recently made its first short walk in its own world, carrying a small cardboard case.

facts: Morning session "orders service: intermittent 502 under load"; the user pasted a stack trace and asked where to start.
Same 502 session all afternoon. The user added logging, reran the load test four times, and said it only fails about one run in five.
A second session "502: check connection pool settings". The user tried raising the pool size; still failing.
Past midnight, still in the connection pool session. Last message 40 minutes ago: "ok I'm going to sleep on it".
New session "502 day 2: reproduce locally". The user is setting up a local load test.
Local reproduction works. The user said "finally, it fails on my machine".
Session renamed "502: upstream timeout vs keepalive". The user is reading proxy docs and comparing timeout values.
steps.chat: Tuck, this bug is eating my whole week.

facts: Late session "try keepalive 75s". The user's last message: "no failures in 20 runs???".
Codex is open but there are no new non-pet sessions in these 5 hours.
Session "502 fix: PR". The user wrote up the root cause (proxy closed idle connections before the service did) and opened a PR.
PR merged. Then a short session "sync main" and another "clean up debug logging".
Evening session "write postmortem for 502 incident"; the user is drafting the timeline section.
Morning session "orders service: add pagination to /orders"; ordinary feature work.
Two sessions: "pagination tests" and "review teammate's PR on retries".
steps.chat: Did you miss me while I was fighting that bug?

facts: Session "postmortem: final edits"; the user said the team review is at 3pm.
